mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.employee_id, r.day, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.employee_id, r.day, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN company c ON b.company_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{companyId}

SELECT r.id, r.employee_id, r.day, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{branchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO register ( employee_id, day, start_of_the_day, entry, exit, break_time, back_to_work ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{day}, #{startOfTheDay}, #{entry}, #{exit}, #{breakTime}, #{backToWork} )
mapper.update: UPDATE register SET employee_id = #{employeeId}, day = #{day}, start_of_the_day= #{startOfTheDay}, entry = #{entry}, exit = #{exit}, break_time = #{breakTime}, back_to_work = #{backToWork} WHERE id = #{id}
